name: Guledagudda Khana Weavers Co-operative Society Ltd.
description: Primary cooperative society representing traditional handloom weavers of the GI-tagged Guledgudd Khana fabric. Coordinates master dobby-loom weavers producing authentic blouse fabrics with auspicious geometric motifs.
location: Bazaar Road, Guledagudda, Bagalkote District, Karnataka 587203
contact_info: Department of Handlooms and Textiles, Bagalkote District
awards_recognition: Geographical Indication (GI) Registered Producer; State Textile Excellence recognition
products_offered: Traditional Khana Blouse Fabrics (Choukadi, Tulasi Katti, Siddeshwara Pheta)
